method: Paired stationary render+gl.finish, 4 warmup and 16 samples, Chromium SwiftShader. Simulation held; excludes active shadow refresh, physics, animation, audio, input and streaming. These figures cannot close the <=5% active-frame or 60/30 FPS targets. Reference and candidate served separately with the same diagnostic API.
